{{Top|leg}}
The '''advanced upgrade slot''' was a module that reprogramed a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] systems to accept upgrades that normally were too advanced for the droid to handle.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
